description: Agent Reputation: submit one reputation summary written for a buyer or principal: its title and audience and the headline score as written, with whether its scale and the number of jobs behind it sit beside it; whether it states the disputes and the failures, where each sits (beside the headline, in a later section, in an appendix or in a separate document) and how many it reports; whether it states the record’s time window, where it sits and its dates; and optionally the underlying record’s job, dispute and failure counts with its first and last job. The signed report says what sits beside the headline score and checks it against the record, and names a summary that leaves out the disputes, the failures or the record’s time window, or reports none against a record that holds some, then counts below the record’s, disclosures in an appendix or a separate document, a window that differs from the record’s and a headline with no scale or job count, with the fix for each. An evaluation summary’s disclosures are wever_evaluation-report-check, a recommendation’s commercial interest is wever_recommendation-disclosure-check and a trust score computed from verified work is wever_agent-trust-scorecard. Verdict headline_only, report_gaps, report_unverified or report_complete. POST /api/reputation-report-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-reputation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-reputation/.
